description: Turtle Canyons is known for the large numbers of sea turtles that float above the reef while the reef fish swim around them and clean their shells. When the turtles come up to breathe they can even be seen by spectators relaxing on the boat! After you have gotten your fill of snorkeling climb back onboard and relax in the sun with complimentary snacks and beverages. Kick back and watch out for spinner dolphins and humpback whales (whales sighted in winter months December to April) while you cruise back to the harbor.
itinerary:
1. On our 20 minute boat cruise to Turtle Canyons our experienced crew will get you set up with snorkeling equipment, give some tips on how to use the gear and talk about what you'll be seeing.
2. We'll arrive at Turtle Canyons and get our most experienced snorkelers in the water right away.
3. Any guests that want a little more help getting the hang of snorkeling can participate in our "snorkel school" at the boat before swimming away to check out Turtle Canyons.
4. Our experienced turtle snorkel guides will be with you in the water the whole time, helping to point out marine life and offer a helping hand if needed.
5. All of our snorkelers will return to the boat, grab something cold to drink and enjoy a snack on our cruise back to the harbor.
highlights:
- Snorkeling with Hawaiian Green Sea Turtles
- Experiencing 'Turtle Canyon' Waikiki's most popular snorkeling location
- Learning about the sea turtles and reef fish that live on Hawaii's coral reefs
- Great Opportunity for photographers

faq_items.question: What to know before your Turtle Canyon Snorkel Tour
faq_items.answer:
Prepare for your adventure at Turtle Canyon Oahu with these essential tips to ensure your trip is smooth and stress-free.

Weather & Cancellations
Safety is our top priority. In the event of unsafe conditions or heavy rain, we will cancel the Turtle Canyon snorkel and notify you immediately via email and text.

Direct Bookings: You can choose between a full refund or rescheduling (subject to availability).

Third-Party Bookings: If you booked via a reseller like Viator, Getyourguide etc. you will have the option to reschedule. For refunds, please contact the specific platform or agency where you purchased your ticket, as their individual policies apply.

Sea Sickness
While the waters are generally calm for turtle snorkeling Waikiki, the ocean can be unpredictable. If you are prone to motion sickness, we provide seasickness bands & Dramamine (seasickness medication) at the dock before departure.

faq_items.question: How often do you see turtles?
faq_items.answer:
Sighting these majestic creatures is a nearly daily occurrence!

While the ocean is a wild place and we can’t exactly put the turtles on a payroll, they are spotted on the vast majority of trips.

Because the reef at Turtle Canyon serves as a natural “cleaning station,” green sea turtles gather here in high numbers to have their shells cleaned by local reef fish. This consistent natural behavior is what makes a Turtle Canyon snorkel adventure one of the most reliable and magical opportunities for snorkeling with turtles in Oahu.

faq_items.question: Why do the Turtles come to turtle canyons?
faq_items.answer:
The reason Turtle Canyon is such a legendary destination is that it serves as a natural, underwater “cleaning station.” Think of it as a high-end day spa for Hawaiian Green Sea Turtles (Honu). These majestic creatures gather at this specific reef because it is home to large populations of reef fish, like the Goldring Surgeonfish and Hawaiian Cleaner Wrasse, which have a very special job.

In a fascinating display of symbiosis, the turtles float effortlessly above the coral while the fish swim around them, picking off algae and parasites from their shells and skin. The fish get an easy meal, and the turtles get a clean, drag-free shell—which is vital for their health and mobility.

This predictable natural behavior is what makes a Turtle Canyon snorkel so unique. Because the turtles are there for a specific purpose, they are often incredibly calm and stationary, allowing for some of the best turtle snorkeling Oahu has to offer.

faq_items.question: What time of year is best for snorkeling with sea turtles in Oahu?
faq_items.answer: Sea turtles can be seen year-round in Oahu, but the summer months (May through September) typically offer the calmest ocean conditions and best underwater visibility. This makes it easier and more enjoyable to spot green sea turtles at popular spots like Turtle Canyons.
